title: Aliens
build: US Activision disk, 'Aliens [Activision].d64', a cracked copy: a Remember cracktro and trainer (22 KB BASIC file at $0801) in front of ten packed game files A0-A9

records.c: Sprite frames $00-$06 in this bank, which the scene does not show.
Sprite frames $04-$06, which the scene does not show.
Sprite frame $07: the lamp, a round light the lift passes.
The scene's entry points: start ($8000) and restart ($8002), both lift_init. The object table addresses after them are all $8028 too: the scene uses no engine objects.
Starts the scene: interrupts off, the bitmap off, the raster call to lift_frame ($8135), the engine's sprite placing off ($045A), and the VIC-II set from the list after the call.
All eight sprites grey ($0C) and frame $07 (the lamp at $41C0), at the places in lamp_places: two columns of four lamps. Then page 6 and the bitmap at $6000 are cleared and the bitmap comes on.
The bitmap on; no key waiting ($0223 = 0); interrupts on.
After 63 frames, unpacks the first picture (lift_picture: screen $5C00, colour, and a hidden bitmap at $E000) and starts sfx_siren.

The ride: the picture appears in the visible bitmap one pixel line every two frames, from the bottom character row up, copied from the hidden bitmap at $E000 (40 bytes a line, 8 apart); while it does, the lamps move up a line each time, so the lift seems to rise. 25 rows of 8 lines.
Each pass: two frames; the lamps' y each one line less (not below 0); then the 40 bytes of this pixel line.
The next character row up: source and destination 320 bytes back.
At the top: sfx_engine, 128 frames, then the second picture over the first (loader_picture: the speech balloon), and the engine loads the next stage at once (stage_skip), the Queen.
Waits 128 frames, unpacks loader_picture and jumps to stage_skip.
The raster call: waits until the raster is above line $FA, then level_frame.
Named by the trainer of level 6, which writes a JMP $814F here; in this scene the low byte of lift_frame's CMP $D012. The poke is meant for the fight's own code, which is not loaded yet.
